title: benchmark-lab: add multi-variant profiling baseline and consolidated reporting pipeline
author: Avery Chen
description: Adds a multi-variant profiling baseline and a consolidated reporting pipeline for the benchmark-lab. Motivation: we need stable, repeatable profiling across model variants (quantized/float16/int8) and consistent reporting for downstream dashboards and automatic regression detection. This PR introduces: 1) representative workload runners that can exercise CPU/GPU/quantized execution paths, 2) profiling baselines (p95/p50/throughput/memory profiles) stored as canonical artifacts, 3) a reporting pipeline that aggregates run results into a normalized JSON schema and uploads to the benchmark metrics bucket, and 4) integration hooks for the existing reporting UI. Checklist: - [x] add multi_variant_runner with mix of short/long sequences and batching profiles - [x] add baseline generation scripts and example baselines - [x] consolidate reporting pipeline into pipeline/reporting_pipeline_v3.yaml - [x] add unit tests for runners and report serializer - [x] update docs/benchlab/metrics.md and add migration notes - [x] CI green and manual validation against last 5 runs Notes: the description contains internal links to the design doc (Linear ENG-4219) and the dashboard PR; artifacts are uploaded to s3://redwood-benchmarks/v3/. This change is backwards-compatible with existing pipelines; migration script included to convert v2 artifacts to v3 format.
